summary: Tyra Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 9,079,000 common shares and, in lieu of shares for certain investors, pre-funded warrants for 9,078,529 shares. Pricing was $22.03 per share and $22.029 per pre-funded warrant (exercise price $0.001), for about $400.0 million gross and $376.0 million net before expenses. Joint book-runners include Jefferies, Guggenheim, Cantor, Barclays and William Blair; closing expected September 15, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
